---
name: Template proposal
about: Propose a new evidence template (a different dispute or record type)
title: "Template: "
labels: template
---

See [`templates/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../templates/CONTRIBUTING.md) first, this is the
lightweight path for adding a new template and covers most of what's needed below.

## What is this template for

The dispute or record type (e.g. tenancy deposit, warranty claim), and who would use it.

## Proposed categories

What evidence categories it needs, and which are required vs recommended vs optional.

## Jurisdiction-specific rules, if any

Privacy patterns (postcodes, ID formats), chronology rules, or guidance text specific to this
template's domain.

## Are you building this yourself?

Say so here if you'd like to submit the `template.yaml` yourself rather than just proposing the
idea.
